kpi.title: Key performance indicators
kpi.description: Summary cards showing key metrics including revenue, units sold, and percentage changes from the previous period.

revenueChart.title: Revenue chart
revenueChart.description: Bar chart displaying revenue and units sold over time. Each bar represents a time period with its corresponding revenue amount and unit count.

topBooks.title: Top performing books
topBooks.description: Table listing your top performing books ranked by revenue, showing title, total revenue, units sold, and average revenue per unit.

platformBreakdown.title: Platform Breakdown

platformBreakdown.description: Visual breakdown of revenue distribution across publishing platforms, showing each platform's revenue amount and percentage of total revenue.
